scoring_justification: The headline quantities are produced by full MD simulations that cannot be re-run in the verifier sandbox; comparison to the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances is the recommended tier in the approved plan.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for all numeric checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values from text and figures: doped MSD surface ~0.0108 Å² (Fig.2, text), max ISD ~0.17 Å² (text), frequency ~0.20 events/ps (text), undoped max ISD ≤0.20 Å² (text), bulk MSD ~0.0046 Å² (text), residence times computed from τ = τ0*exp(ΔH/(RT)) with τ0=0.1 ps, ΔH=30 kJ/mol.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper text/figures and the kinetic expression computed analytically.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are the paper's own reported numbers or exact analytical derivations, ensuring that a correct reproduction matches the reference.

doped.description: Oxygen dynamics in the Ca-doped CeO2(011) slab: msd_vs_depth is an array of [depth_center_A, O_MSD_Ang2]; max_isd_ang2 (float); frequency_per_ps (float).

undoped.description: Oxygen dynamics in the undoped CeO2(011) slab: msd_vs_depth array; max_isd_ang2 (float).

bulk_doped_msd_ang2.description: Overall oxygen MSD in the Ca-doped CeO2 bulk at 300 K (Angstrom^2).

residence_times.description: Estimated adsorbate residence times (ps) at 300 K and 700 K.

outputs.description: Compiled molecular dynamics results to be compared against the paper's reported values for MSD depth profiles, maximum ISD, event frequency, and residence time estimates.

output_contract.notes: All values are at 300 K except where noted. The checker will compare each quantity to the paper's reported reference with appropriate tolerances, giving highest weight to the doped-slab MSD and max ISD.

steps.description: Oxygen MSD of the outermost surface slice (highest |depth_center|) in the doped slab.
Maximum individual-ion squared displacement (ISD) among topmost surface oxygen ions in the doped slab.
Frequency of large-amplitude displacement events (ISD > ~0.1 Å²) in the doped slab.
Upper bound check: undoped slab max ISD must be ≤ 0.20 Å².
Oxygen MSD in the Ca-doped CeO2 bulk at 300 K.
Adsorbate residence times τ = τ0*exp(ΔH/(RT)) with τ0=0.1 ps, ΔH=30 kJ/mol. Score both 300K and 700K values against exact computation with 10% relative tolerance.
